headline: A 2020 Senate resolution would have blocked a proposed arms sale of certain military equipment and services to the United Arab Emirates, but the Senate did not take it up.
what_it_does: This joint resolution would have disapproved a proposed foreign military sale to the United Arab Emirates of specified defense articles and services. If adopted, it would have prohibited that sale from going forward. The official summary does not list the specific equipment covered, so the exact items are not described here. The Senate refused to take up or end debate on the measure on December 9, 2020, so it did not pass.

who_it_affects.group: The United Arab Emirates government and its military
who_it_affects.how: It would have been barred from receiving the specified U.S. defense articles and services under the proposed sale.

who_it_affects.group: U.S. defense contractors that would have supplied the equipment
who_it_affects.how: They would not have been able to complete the proposed sale of the covered items to the United Arab Emirates.
